title: Jets GM Darren Mougey: We'll find a way to keep Breece Hall here if we can't get a deal done

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jets GM Darren Mougey: We'll find a way to keep Breece Hall here if we can't get a deal done
sources.description: It doesn't look like Jets running back Breece Hall will be hitting the open market when the new league year opens next month.
